The Explorer pinball machine, manufactured by Sega Enterprises, Ltd. in 1972, is an electro-mechanical game with a space exploration theme.

- Manufacturer: Sega Enterprises, Ltd.
- Years made: 1972–1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Space, Original Theme, 1970s, Sci-Fi
